title: 第100章 摊牌了，我就是小诗仙！
novel_title: 唐逸孔诗岚全文完结版
content_zh: 刘州的话，虽然引起了很多人的不满。　　但是，他有个好爹。　　他爹是户部尚书，权势滔天。　　他放个屁说是香的，都会有无数人附和。　　因此他提出将唐逸赶出沈园，立即就有很多人附和起来。　　“没错，沈园诗会如此高雅之地，岂能容垃圾放肆。”　　“滚出去，只会作弊的废物，没资格站在这里。”　　“就你这种蠢货也想娶孔姑娘？做梦去吧！”　　“……”　　顷刻间，唐逸就被千夫所指。　　女人看向唐逸的目光充满厌恶，男人看向唐逸的目光充满嘲讽，虽然这么做有点不厚道，可那又如何呢？　　要怪，只能怪他不受宠，已经是唐家弃子了！　　“呵，看到他们的样子了吗？知道像什么吗？像一群小丑。”　　不远处，龙斩靠着靠椅，眯着眼睛瞅着唐逸：“为了利益，黑的都能说成败的，臭的都能说成香的……”　　“说我们黑，有这些当权者在，这个世道，比我们更黑。”　　孙霸扭了扭脖子，又捏了捏拳：“黑？等下我会让他们知道我更黑，舵主今日你可别拦我，我要大开杀戒。”　　“咳咳……”龙斩咳嗽两声，又咳血了。　　他擦掉嘴角的血迹，道：“杀什么？这些都是钱。”　　“等下杀了皇帝，将所有人全部抓住，然后通知他们的家族，花钱赎人吧！”　　听到这话，孙霸顿时瞪大双眼：“舵主，你这玩得太大了吧？一次性将整个京都豪族一锅端了。”　　“但是，我喜欢！”　　“嘘。”龙斩竖起一根手指在唇边，笑了起来。　　“知道就行了，不要说出来。”　　“现场有炎文帝安插的不少高手，他们的耳朵还是很灵的。”　　孙霸看了一眼站在舞台边缘，手始终按在刀柄上的御前司指挥使赵虎，眼底杀意肆虐，听说这家伙是皇帝身边的护卫，京都第二高手。　　今日，倒是要看看他能接住几刀不死！　　“咳咳，唐侍郎，教育长子的同时，也不要荒废对幼子的教育嘛！”　　男人席位的最前方，刘温听着周围的议论声，玩味地看向唐敬：“三元及第的长子成了京都的传奇，可别让小儿子，废成了另一个传奇！”　　唐敬扭头看向刘温，反唇相讥：“那也比不上刘尚书，刘尚书的家教，才真正让人佩服啊！”　　他虽然不喜欢唐逸和唐逸，但刘州众目睽睽之下和唐音说这种话，依旧让他心头很不爽。　　“呵，刘州只不过是说了个事实而已。”　　刘温却丝毫不在意，撇了撇嘴道：“唐侍郎，难道他说的不是事实？”　　唐敬脸色铁青，没有接话。　　刘州虽然话说得难听，但说的的确是事实。　　甚至连买诗的事，他都深信不疑。　　“两位，这时候就别内斗了。”　　赵轲干咳一声，道：“现在我们的敌人，是小诗仙，解决了小诗仙，两位再坐下来商讨家教的事情。”　　听到这话，原本看戏的一众大臣，脸色都难看了下来。　　舞台上就那么几十个人，他们早就逐一甄别过了，压根就没一个符合小诗仙形象的参赛者。　　“不急，今日他会出现的，只要他出现，知道他是谁，要对付他，手段多了去！”　　刘温咬牙切齿，恶狠狠道。　　这狗屁的小诗仙，这段时间将他们折腾得够呛。　　等确定了他的身份，不将他抽筋拔骨，难消心头之恨。　　此时，宇文封目光也在盯着唐逸。　　耳边对唐逸不堪的嘲讽声不断入耳，听着这些声音，宇文封的目光充满轻蔑和不屑。　　“这就是大炎，就是号称君子之国的国度，真是……太可笑了！”　　宇文封冷笑一声，道：“大敌当前，他们竟然还想着内斗，呵呵，等北狄大军兵临城下，都不过是一群待宰的猪羊罢了。”　　述里虎也是满脸的讥讽，道：“还是王子殿下看得透彻，就这样的大炎，不需要外敌，他们就能内耗亡国。”　　宇文封双手枕着头，舔了舔唇瓣道：“是啊，他们内耗就能亡国，可……这是我们养肥的牛羊，要死，也只能死在我们手中。”　　“自相残杀，那多没意思！”　　宇文封摩着指腹，其实，他今日更想亲手宰了炎文帝。　　有什么事情，能比亲手将一个国家的皇帝踩在脚下，更有意思呢？　　他来大炎不就是为了等这样一个机会吗？　　与此同时，东虞使馆这边，秦钰看着这一幕，也不由皱了皱眉。　　“他就是唐逸，那个炎文帝给小诗仙找的替身？”　　她盯着唐逸，眸色微凝，像是温言锋，又像是自言自语。　　所有人都在嘲讽这个少年，她却从这少年身上看到了一些不一样的东西。　　他太从容，太淡定了。　　十八岁的年纪，正是热血上头的时候，一般人遇到这种情况，多少会有一点愤怒或者怨恨。　　但是，唐逸没有。　　这种人怎么可能会是废物？　　言锋看了一眼秦钰，便知道了她的想法，笑道：“没错，他就是唐逸，也是炎文帝给小诗仙找的替身。”　　“我们将他的资料前前后后整合过了，得出的结论，就是他不可能是小诗仙。”　　秦钰看向言锋，道：“有时候最不可能的，往往就是答案！”　　“也罢，好戏才刚开始，且看他怎么破这个局吧！”　　“如果连这个局都破不了，那他的确不可能是我要找的小诗仙。”　　而在不远处的阁楼中，高阳公主萧澜看着这一幕，也是气得咬牙切齿。　　一群贱人，竟然敢欺负我孩子她爹！　　“我看不下去了，我去收拾她们。”　　萧澜攥着粉拳，转身就往阁楼外走。　　“不行，你不可以出去，今日，你只能在这里。”　　孔诗岚直接拉住萧澜的手腕，道：“你现在出去帮不了他，反而会让人觉得唐逸是借你的势压人。”　　“到时候，他的处境会更难。”　　孔诗岚将萧澜按坐在椅子上，道：“既然唐逸有信心，那就让他自己先解决，他要是解决不了，你再去解决就是了。”　　萧澜咬着薄唇，美眸有着烈火在燃烧。　　但她不是傻子，知道孔诗岚说得对，现在出去更像是以身份压人，让唐逸的处境更加不堪。　　这时，唐逸的声音传来。　　“原来是梁绍，给你们说我买的诗啊？”　　“可我用自己的诗……应该不算买吧？”　　唐逸居高临下盯着得意的刘州和唐画，嘴角笑容玩味。　　“有没有一种可能，我就是你们要找的小诗仙。”　　“好吧，我摊牌了，我，唐逸，就是你们要找的小诗仙！”　　原本喧嚣的鹿鸣湖，瞬间陷入死寂！
content_en: Although Liu Zhou's words caused dissatisfaction among many people.But he has a good father.His father is the Minister of Household Affairs and has great power.If he farts and says it smells good, countless people will echo him.Therefore, he proposed to drive Tang Yi out of Shen Yuan, and many people immediately agreed."That's right, Shen Yuan Poetry Club is such an elegant place, how can we allow garbage to run rampant." "Get out, you are a cheating trash, you have no right to stand here." "A fool like you wants to marry Miss Kong? Just dream!" "..." In an instant, Tang Yi was criticized by thousands of people.The woman looked at Tang Yi with disgust, and the man looked at Tang Yi with ridicule. Although this was a bit unkind, so what?If you want to blame him, you can only blame him for not being favored. He is already an abandoned son of the Tang family!"Ha, have you seen what they look like? Do you know what they look like? Like a group of clowns." Not far away, Long Zhan leaned on the armchair and looked at Tang Yi with squinted eyes: "For the sake of profit, the black ones can be said to be successful or not, and the smelly ones can be said to be fragrant..." "You can say that we are black, because of thisThere are people in power in this world who are darker than us." Sun Ba twisted his neck and clenched his fists: "Black?I will let them know later that I am even darker. Captain, please don't stop me today.I will go on a killing spree." "Ahem..." Long Zhan coughed twice and coughed up blood again.He wiped the blood from the corner of his mouth and said, "Kill for what? These are money." "Kill the emperor later, catch everyone, and then notify their families and spend money to redeem people!" Upon hearing this, Sun Ba's eyes widened immediately: "Captain, are you playing too big a game? You've killed the entire Kyoto wealthy family at once." "But, I like it!" "Shh." Long Zhan raised a finger to his lips and laughed."Just know it, don't tell it." "There are many masters deployed by Emperor Yan Wen here, and their ears are still very good." Sun Ba glanced at Zhao Hu, the commander of the imperial department, who was standing on the edge of the stage, his hand always pressed on the hilt of his sword. Killing intent was raging in his eyes. I heard that this guy was the emperor's bodyguard and the second master in Kyoto.Today, we want to see how many knives he can take without dying!"Ahem, Minister Tang, while educating the eldest son, don't neglect the education of the younger son!" At the front of the men's seat, Liu Wen listened to the discussions around him and looked at Tang Jing playfully: "The eldest son of Sanyuan Jidi has become a legend in Kyoto, but don't let the younger son become another one.A legend!" Tang Jing turned to look at Liu Wen and retorted: "That's not as good as Liu Shangshu.Liu Shangshu's tutor is truly admirable!" Although he didn't like Tang Yi and Tang Yi, Liu Zhou still felt uncomfortable saying such things to Tang Yin in front of everyone."Oh, Liu Zhou just told a fact." Liu Wen didn't care at all. He curled his lips and said, "Shilang Tang, could it be that what he said is not the truth?" Tang Jing's face was ashen and he did not answer.Although Liu Zhou’s words sounded unpleasant, they were indeed true.He even believed in buying poems."You two, let's stop fighting among ourselves at this time." Zhao Ke coughed dryly and said, "Now our enemy is the little Shixian. After taking care of the little Shixian, you two can sit down and discuss the matter of tutoring." Upon hearing this, the faces of all the ministers who were watching the show turned ugly.There were only dozens of people on the stage. They had already screened them one by one, and there was no contestant who fit the image of the little Shixian."Don't worry, he will show up today. As long as he shows up and knows who he is, there are many ways to deal with him!" Liu Wen gritted his teeth and said fiercely.This bullshit little poetry fairy has tormented them quite a lot during this time.Once his identity is confirmed, it will be difficult to get rid of the hatred in his heart without tearing out his muscles and bones.At this time, Yu Wenfeng was also staring at Tang Yi.Tang Yi's unbearable taunts kept ringing in his ears. Listening to these voices, Yu Wenfeng's eyes were filled with contempt and disdain."This is Dayan, a country known as the country of gentlemen. It's really... so ridiculous!" Yu Wenfeng sneered and said: "In the face of a powerful enemy, they still want to fight among themselves. Haha, when the Beidi army comes to the city, they are just a group of pigs and sheep to be slaughtered." Shulihu also had a face full of sarcasm, saying: "His Royal Highness still sees clearly, that's it.Great Yan, they can destroy the country through internal strife without external enemies." Yu Wenfeng put his head on his hands and licked his lips and said, "Yes, they can destroy the country through internal strife, but...these are our fattened cattle and sheep, and they can only die in our hands." "It would be boring to kill each other!" Yu Wenfeng rubbed his fingertips. In fact, he wanted to kill Emperor Yanwen with his own hands today.What could be more interesting than trampling the emperor of a country under your feet with your own hands?Didn’t he come to Dayan just to wait for such an opportunity?At the same time, at the Dongyu Embassy, ​​Qin Yu couldn't help but frowned when he saw this scene."He is Tang Yi, the substitute that Emperor Yan Wen found for Xiao Shixian?" She stared at Tang Yi, her eyes slightly condensed, like Wen Yanfeng, or talking to herself.Everyone was mocking this young man, but she saw something different in this young man.He was too calm, too calm.The eighteen-year-old age is when passion comes to the fore. When ordinary people encounter this kind of situation, they will feel a little angry or resentful.But, Tang Yi didn't.How could such a person be a waste?Yan Feng glanced at Qin Yu and knew what she was thinking, and said with a smile: "Yes, he is Tang Yi, and he is also the substitute that Emperor Yan Wen found for Xiao Shixian." "We integrated his information one after another, and came to the conclusion that he cannot be Xiao Shixian." Qin Yu looked at Yan Feng and said: "Sometimes it is best toImpossible is often the answer!" "Well, the fun has just begun, let's see how he can break this game!" "If he can't break this game, then he really can't be the little poetry fairy I'm looking for." In the attic not far away, Princess Xiao Lan of Gaoyang was gritting her teeth in anger.A bunch of bitches dare to bully my child’s father!"I can't stand it anymore. I'll go deal with them." Xiao Lan clenched her pink fist and turned around to go out of the attic.
title_en: Chapter 100 Showdown, I am the Little Shixian!
